+module Library.Book where
+
+import Library.CatalogItem
+
+template Book
+  with
+    owner : Party
+    author : Text
+    title : Text
+    loanedTo : Optional Party
+    observers : [Party]
+  where
+    signatory owner
+    observer observers
+
+    interface instance CatalogItem for Book where

+
+      discloseTo newObservers = do
+        disclosedBook <- create this with

+        pure (toInterfaceContractId disclosedBook)
+
+      loanTo borrower = do
+        loanedBook <- create this with loanedTo = Some borrower
+        pure (toInterfaceContractId loanedBook)
+
+      returnToOwner = do
